mentions.name: Hand-typed typewriter letters
mentions.description: This project puts a circa-1940 family heirloom typewriter to use by hand-typing and shipping custom-made letters of up to 280 characters, finished with other personal touches.
mentions.source_excerpt: My wife challenged me to make a project. Now Im getting my wheels turning with a new project to type and ship letters custom made with 280 chars and some other personal touches.
